cases.relevance: High for route and exposure; imperfect biology
cases.forecast_evidence: Reused dated Needham quotation; no matched annual curve
cases.commercial_direction: Mixed by horizon; long-target miss in one forecast
cases.preapproval_belief: Aug.1 2016 Needham quotation expected more than $5bn worldwide sales in 2022; this is one analyst, outside the primary vintage window.
cases.observed: Biogen reported $1,793.5m in 2022. That is more than 64% below the quoted threshold; early launch enthusiasm is not evidence of long-run forecast accuracy.
cases.mechanism_hypothesis: Initial prevalent-patient conversion and loading can accelerate early revenue; competing therapies and switches can reduce later product share.
cases.competing_explanations: Do not conflate total SMA market growth with Spinraza revenue. Age, disease severity, newborn screening and intrathecal feasibility differ from SYNGAP1.
cases.cmp_model_use: Use a loading/maintenance cohort model, procedure capacity and competitor scenarios. Do not copy SMA efficacy or patient penetration into SYNGAP1.
cases.missing_data: Original Needham model and primary-vintage reports; quarterly US/global patient starts, maintenance and switches; documented PoS treatment.
cases.claim_status: Observed source facts distinguished from investigator mechanism/transfer hypotheses; not causal attribution
cases.population_matching_status: Not independently quantified on consistent date/label/territory basis; no numerical TAM-distance score assigned.

cases.relevance: High for repeated CNS delivery and function preservation
cases.forecast_evidence: Actual trajectory available; authentic preapproval annual curve missing
cases.preapproval_belief: No usable original preapproval annual model recovered. An undated or unspecified peak estimate cannot be converted into a launch curve.
cases.observed: Reported global revenues rose from about $8.6m in 2017 to $39.9m in 2018, $72.0m in 2019 and $110.192m in 2020. These calendar years do not equal first 36 commercial months.
cases.mechanism_hypothesis: A working delivery network and timely diagnosis can matter as much as prevalence. Preserving function and reversing lost development are distinct claims.
cases.competing_explanations: CLN2 is degenerative; SYNGAP1 developmental impairment may have a different reversible component. ICV infusion is operationally different from lumbar intrathecal dosing.
cases.cmp_model_use: Use center activation, visits per patient, treatment delays and age/function strata; no numerical penetration transfer without matched patient data.
cases.missing_data: 2016–2017 original BioMarin models, forecast launch dates, quarterly early revenues and original label/center capacity history.
cases.claim_status: Observed source facts distinguished from investigator mechanism/transfer hypotheses; not causal attribution
cases.population_matching_status: Not independently quantified on consistent date/label/territory basis; no numerical TAM-distance score assigned.

cases.mechanism_hypothesis: A few patients and the timing of paid access can materially change revenue in an ultra-small cohort.
cases.competing_explanations: Free drug, compassionate access, country reimbursement and dosing by weight can mimic penetration changes. This is not evidence of a large latent population becoming commercial.
cases.cmp_model_use: Model counts and treated patient-months directly at the low end; retain uncertainty in genetic confirmation and access. Do not use peripheral ERT efficacy to predict neurological rescue.
cases.missing_data: 2016/2017 annual forecasts, original risk/geography assumptions, paid versus free access and quarterly country revenue.

cases.competing_explanations: New territories, formulation changes and follow-up length can confound apparent persistence. Oral experience cannot fix intrathecal willingness.

data_dictionary.unit: Drug–indication pair; raw frame rows are approvals/products, not independent forecast outcomes.
data_dictionary.classification: Provisional clinical scope/first-status screen; does not certify scientific DMT status.
data_dictionary.source_locator: Worksheet row or document table/section; raw source preserved where feasible.
data_dictionary.forecast_usdm: Observed quoted nominal USD millions, without imputed PoS correction.
data_dictionary.actual_usdm: Observed recognized net product revenue; consolidated worldwide unless specified.
data_dictionary.raw_actual_over_forecast_minus_1: Derived A/F−1; positive means raw actual exceeds quoted forecast. Not normalized forecast bias.
data_dictionary.break_even_scalar_pos: Hypothetical F/A where F=p×conditional forecast; not an estimate of actual approval probability.
data_dictionary.strict_36m_eligible: Requires complete matched first 36 commercial months, original disease, geography, revenue basis, currency, vintage and known conditionality.
data_dictionary.dimensions: Investigator qualitative relevance on biology, age/window, diagnosis, administration and exposure; no outcome-fitted composite score.
data_dictionary.commercial_direction: Unknown unless target-specific evidence exists. Immaturity/access gaps are not commercial failures.
data_dictionary.source_reuse: Marked where earlier verified evidence is used after independent case selection.
data_dictionary.knowledge_time: Preapproval forecast beliefs are separated from subsequent company explanations and investigator hypotheses.
